senses.definition: present participle and gerund of admit
examples: For quotations using this term, see Citations:admitting.

senses.definition: An act of admission; an allowing to enter.

quotes.text: Other parts of the ceremony have their unpleasantnesses; for there is great difficulty in admittings and omittings of guests to the festivities.
